entries.target: A short range attack that deals damage to 1 target.
entries.officialDescription: Gain a stack of Chaos Rift, stacking to 4 and lasting 8 seconds and being used for other abilities. Each strike affects your and your opponent’s Sight, raising your Hit Chance and lowering theirs by 3% per stack. If Temporal Eclipse is active, your strikes additionally affect your and your opponent’s Focus, raising your Dodge and lowering theirs by 3% per stack. Both stack to 5 and last 10 seconds.

entries.target: A long range attack that deals damage to 1 target.
entries.officialDescription: Mark your opponent, damaging them and increasing incoming damage to your opponent by 20% for 10 seconds. If Temporal Eclipse is active, instead converge the shadows upon your foe, consuming all your Chaos Rift and inflicting your opponent with a heavy DoT based on how much damage was dealt in the past 10 seconds while it was active.
